recentItems.title: Dances of Maya Plisetskaya - 1959 document
recentItems.description:
This is my all time favourite document (profile) about dancer. It is already on YT in worse quality, I´ve obtained this better one from Russia.
Maya Plisetskaya (with Olga Lepeshinskaya and Galina Ulanova) my favourite ballerina. The same as Lepeshinskaya, her dancing is full of life and energy. Great artist, not gymnast of nowdays.
I know there exist a smilar documentary about my favourite male ballet dancer Yuri Soloviev, but I can´t get it.
